details.--prefix: Add --prefix TEXT, default empty, and test a literal prefix before the greeting.
details.--suffix: Add --suffix TEXT, default empty, and test a literal suffix after the greeting.
details.--separator: Add --separator TEXT, default comma and space, and test replacing the delimiter after Hello.
details.--repeat: Add --repeat COUNT (1 through 5, default 1) and test one greeting per output line.
